description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and quality-focused Application Tester to evaluate software applications and ensure they function correctly, meet business requirements, and provide a reliable user experience. The ideal candidate will have strong testing and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify defects, validate application functionality, and collaborate with development and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities
  • Execute manual and automated tests to validate application functionality and quality.
  • Review requirements, user stories, and specifications to identify testing needs.
  • Create and maintain test cases, test scenarios, test scripts, and testing documentation.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, system, usability, and exploratory testing.
  • Identify, reproduce, document, and track application defects.
  • Provide clear reproduction steps, expected results, actual results, and supporting evidence for reported issues.
  • Retest resolved defects and perform regression testing after application updates.
  • Validate application functionality against business and technical requirements.
  • Perform cross-browser, cross-platform, mobile, and device testing when required.
  • Test application interfaces, workflows, integrations, and data flows.
  • Collaborate with developers, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to investigate and resolve issues.
  • Monitor testing results and communicate quality risks and concerns.
  • Support release testing, deployment validation, and production verification activities.
  • Maintain accurate records of test results, defects, and testing progress.
  • Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tools, and application quality.
Required Skills
  • Strong understanding of software testing and quality assurance principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Experience creating and executing test cases and test scenarios.
  • Ability to identify, reproduce, and clearly document application defects.
  • Familiarity with bug tracking and test management tools.
  • Understanding of functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing.
  • Knowledge of web and mobile application testing.
  • Basic knowledge of APIs, databases, and SQL is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with automated testing concepts and tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and professionally.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Requirements
  • Previous experience as an Application Tester, QA Tester, Software Tester, or similar role.
  • Hands-on experience testing software applications.
  • Experience creating and executing manual test cases.
  • Experience identifying, documenting, and tracking software defects.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, TestRail, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Experience performing functional and regression testing.
  • Understanding of software development and release processes.
  • Ability to analyze requirements and translate them into effective test scenarios.
  • Experience testing web, mobile, or desktop applications.
  • Strong computer and digital skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple testing activities while meeting deadlines.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable setup for remote work.
  • Professional, analytical, dependable, and quality-focused attitude.
  • English proficiency is required if the position involves working with English-speaking teams or technical documentation.
By applying to this position, we’ll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match.
